payload.title: Arm hard claim enforcement on the dogfood repo
payload.body: The collision-free CLAIM mechanism is proven, but enforcement is advisory by default, so an agent that does not claim (or uses --no-verify, or clones without the hook) can still push code with no live claim -> two agents collide. This is THE gap for '99% cannot conflict'. Arm it: gh variable set TASKS_CLAIM_ENFORCE=1; make tasks-claim-check required on the main ruleset; protect tasks-claims and main from force-push/delete. Threat model B5/B6/B7 + fleet-phase3-server-side-enforcement. Depends on the claim-check workflow actually running first.
payload.blocked: needs-user-approval — requires repo-settings: set TASKS_CLAIM_ENFORCE=1, mark tasks-claim-check a REQUIRED status check on main, and add a ruleset blocking force-push/delete of tasks-claims + main
